observation.visible_scene: A dance/fitness studio with a wood floor and a full-height mirrored wall fronted by a ballet barre. A man in a black sleeveless shirt, colorful 'ZUMBA' print shorts and multicolor sneakers stands in the foreground with his back to the camera; his front-facing reflection and several other class participants are visible in the mirror. The camera is static (mirror frame, ceiling and wall panels hold fixed positions throughout); all apparent motion is the subject's own body movement, not camera movement.
visible_changes: t=0.0–0.13: the man marches with his right heel lifted behind him and both arms held out to the sides, slightly bent.
t=0.2–0.33: he draws his arms in, bending the elbows into a jogging/clenched-fist position at chest height while the right foot stays lifted.
t=0.4–0.53: the arms rise, elbows bent with fists near the head, then begin extending upward.
t=0.6–0.8: both arms are fully raised overhead in a wide V while he balances on the left leg with the right knee bent and foot lifted behind.
t=0.87–1.0: the overhead arms lower back down to shoulder height and then to the sides.
t=1.07–1.27: arms rest at his sides as he continues a stepping/marching motion, right foot swinging.
t=1.34–1.47: the right arm swings outward and then lifts upward with a clenched fist as the torso rotates slightly to the right; the right leg lifts behind.
t=1.54–1.94: he holds the right arm raised while the body turns further right (more of his right side shown) and the legs cross as he pivots.
t=2.0–2.14: the raised arm switches to the left (extended overhead with fist) while the right leg extends out to the right side, foot off the floor, in a side-extension stance.
t=2.27–2.47: the left arm stays extended overhead and the right leg remains stretched out to the side as he holds the leaning side pose.
t=2.54–2.67: the left arm lowers and the extended right leg draws back in as he steps, ending mid-stride with arms near the sides.
The mirror reflection tracks these same arm and leg positions in a front-facing view, and the background class members make small independent movements throughout.
outside_clip_unknowns: The routine is already in progress at the first frame and continues past the last; the start and completion of the dance sequence are not shown.
Audio/music driving the rhythm is not visible.
The identities and full choreography of the other class members are only partially visible as reflections.
uncertain_details: Exact step names (e.g. whether the right-leg side extension is a kick, tap or lunge) cannot be confirmed from the poses alone.
Precise foot-contact moments are ambiguous due to frame sampling.
The cause of the torso rotation is not visible; only the resulting change in body orientation is shown.
